# Attestation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Attestation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)

A reified assertion envelope that an attester vouches for a claim, artifact, identity binding, process, quality report, or ledger claim under a specific policy. Mediates between an attester, an attested subject, and optionally an attested claim or artifact. Distinct from [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md): an attestation is a vouching act, not a measurement or sensory reading. Its validity window is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil; revocation sets [`validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md) ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
